description: This file defines a 'CartPage' UI component using LightningJS, composing various subcomponents and managing a checkout modal's visibility via application state subscription.

classes.name: CartPage
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the shopping cart page, including header, cart view, floating action button, and checkout modal.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the component's reactive state, setting 'checkoutOpen' to false.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Sets up a subscription to the AppStore to update 'checkoutOpen' based on application state changes.
